scope: CPU audit of a generic open-string study neck; no hand, browser/WebGL, touch or physical iPad approval.

checks.name: Six actual open-string meshes retain standard numbering, notes, and decreasing gauges
Every actual board-side tube ring follows the unpressed nut-to-end string path
Projection anchors and radii come from actual tube rings on the open string paths
Twelve actual fret crowns follow equal temperament, with fret 12 at half scale
Fingerboard taper and curved D-back retain their declared physical dimensions
All six open strings clear all twelve fret crowns across their full 2.2 mm width
Actual nut groove vertices meet each corresponding string bottom
The 14 degree headstock has six separate complete tuning machines in a 3+3 arrangement
The visible headstock veneer faces outward with a FrontSide material
Board top, D-back and fret crown surface normals face outward
Neck, board, nut, fret and headstock solids are watertight after UV-seam welding
Geometry has finite attributes, valid indices and at most 20,000 triangles / 75 meshes
